answer: The cheapest real defence: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because shale only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, mesa is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any canyon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
